name: TrackMe: add tracking
cancelled: This order is cancelled: nothing to ship.
busy: A TrackMe job is working on this order right now. Try again when it's done.
overWeightLimit: Over the {{limit}} kg limit per parcel, and auto split is off: it will ship as one heavy parcel.
pickup: Pickup order: it gets no AWB. Print its label from Print → TrackMe: label.
nothingToShip: Nothing left to ship by courier on this order.
fixZip: Fix the ZIP code in the order's shipping address, then try again.
nextSteps: To print the label: Print → TrackMe: label.
